prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production game texture for a physically rendered spherical ice planet in a cinematic 3D space exploration game.
Create ONLY a seamless equirectangular planet surface color texture, 2:1 landscape aspect ratio, preferably 2048 by 1024 pixels. It will be wrapped around a real 3D sphere with real lighting. Flat map texture, absolutely no globe, no outer space, no stars, no cast shadows, no directional light, no text, no UI.
Subject: a magnificent luminous frozen ocean world. Vast blue-grey ice basins, intricate branching frost fissures, pale blue continental ice shelves, sprawling brilliant ivory glacier systems, feathery glacial striations, realistic satellite planetary cartography at very large scale. Cold pearly white and glacial powder blue dominate with darker slate blue irregular basin patterns for beautiful contrast. Natural intricate geological detail with both large sweeping structures and fine ice crack networks. No lunar impact craters, no brown rock, no green land, no recognizable Earth geography, no tiny repetitive noise everywhere, no regular waves or stripes.
Texture illumination is perfectly neutral and diffuse: the image is base color, with no painted atmosphere, no painted horizon, no edge shading or vignette. Match left and right edges seamlessly, polar features converge gently at the top and bottom, preserve detailed clean readable ice features. Sophisticated cinematic semi-realism, exquisite true ice surface, suitable for a large blue planet seen from orbit in a game.
